reviews.title: Deceptive charging
reviews.text:
They advertise and offer you $1 for the service, and you simply authorize payment for that; but they don't mention that they'll automatically charge you a monthly fee or subscription. Apps like this aren't worth it because they trick customers.
Te roban, es engañosa, no la usen. 
Pagué $1 por curiosidad y terminaron cobrándome $30. Eviten esta aplicación.
reviews.reply:
Hi [Name], 

We`re sorry to hear about your negative experience with the payment process. Please rest assured that we`re here to ensure a smoother journey for you.

We want you to feel confident and informed every step of the way. That`s why we clearly outline all the details about the service and any upcoming payments if applicable on the offer screen. We’re here to make things easy — so if anything isn`t clear, just let us know!

We want to make the payment process as clear and seamless as possible. Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com, and our team will help resolve any concerns.

Wishing you the best, Nebula team 🔮

reviews.title: Unauthorised charge!! Do not waste your money and time!!
reviews.text: This app-disguised scam trap took 49.99 out of nowhere when I just accepted a 3 days free trial and never authorised other charge . Be careful. Apple shouldn’t allow this low pseudo apps to run in their market. I’ve been robbed literally.
reviews.reply:
Hi dear User,  
  
Thanks for telling us your opinion on the matter of our service.  
  
We`re sorry to hear about your negative experience with the payment process. Please rest assured that we`re here to ensure a smoother journey for you.  
  
It looks like the default subscription was selected when you proceeded after tapping the ‘Continue` button. This may have happened because the desired subscription wasn`t chosen on the sales screen.  
  
We want to make the payment process as clear and seamless as possible. Please contact us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and our team will help resolve any concerns.  
  
Kindest regards, Nebula team 🔮

reviews.title: Pésimo
reviews.text: Te indican que puedes utilizar un chat por 3 minutos al pagar 1 dólar y luego te quieren cobrar una suscripción sin permiso y sin haber concedido algún permiso. La peor app que puede existir.
reviews.reply:
Hi dear!

Thanks for telling us your opinion on the matter of our service.

We regret hearing about your concerns with the payment. We`re dedicated to creating a more seamless experience for you moving forward.

I want to shed some light on the situation in detail:

When ordering a subscription or other service on our service, we provide all information about the order and cancellation,

Information also sent to the mail to notify you about it.

As for the 3 minutes in the chat with experts, you can use them and be sure that it is not connected to a subscription.

In order to use the chats you need credits which you can purchase if you wish.

Your satisfaction is our priority. If there`s anything unclear about the payment, don`t hesitate to reach out to us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and we`ll provide the assistance you need.

Take care and stay inspired, Nebula team 🔮

reviews.title: Cobro no autorizado
reviews.text: Solo me suscribí por periodo de prueba y me cobraron 39.99 sin autorizar, les mande un correo hace mas de una semana y no me han contestado
reviews.reply:
Hi there! Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We’re truly sorry to hear about the unauthorized charge and the delay in responding to your email. This is not the experience we want for our users, and we’re committed to resolving this issue as soon as possible.

Please reach out to us again at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com with details about your account and the transaction. Our team is available 24/7 and will prioritize resolving this for you.

Wishing you clarity and peace,
Nebula Team! ✨

reviews.title: Me están robando
reviews.text: Jamás acepté ninguna forma de pago y ahora me están cobrando y no hay manera de quitar esa suscripción muy mal !
reviews.reply:
Hola estimado [Name],

Lamentamos mucho saber que estás teniendo problemas con tu suscripción. Queremos asegurarte que estamos aquí para ayudarte a resolver este inconveniente.

Si no has aceptado ningún pago, es posible que haya habido un malentendido. Por favor, contáctanos directamente a nuestro soporte al cliente con más detalles sobre tu cuenta y la situación, y haremos todo lo posible para resolverlo y reembolsarte si es necesario.

Apreciamos tus comentarios y queremos asegurarnos de que tengas una experiencia positiva con nosotros.

Saludos,
[Agent] del equipo de Nebula 🔮
